linhas.en: "We've seen once again for ourselves the karmic consequences of a maid fetish. It's practically a mortal sin."

linhas.en: "Even this ema gallery mode was actually added just as a way to look at the maids' bare legs.[lr]
linhas.Pt-br: "Até esse modo de galeria de ema, no fim, foi incluído só para admirar as pernas descobertas das empregadas.[lr]
linhas.label: $$$message_0311_0005_0000$$$

linhas.en: ...Wait, Saber,[wvl canskip=0 time=400] we're talking about you, though."

linhas.en: "Is it not gratifying to have more outfits, in any case?"
